nodes.name: Load Posted Log
nodes.notes: Reads every row of the run log. Fails loudly: if we cannot read what was already posted, we must not post.

nodes.name: Respect Crawl Delay
nodes.notes: robots.txt sets Crawl-delay: 3, which is stricter than the brief's 1 req/s. We honour the stricter number.

nodes.name: Build Validator Request
nodes.notes: The reviewer sees only the source and the finished post — never the generator’s own grounding_notes.

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $json;
return [{ json: { ...d, needsApproval: d.run.reviewMode === 'approval' } }];

nodes.name: Wait For Approval
nodes.notes: Resumes when the reviewer opens one of the two links. Times out after 24h, which routes to Record Outcome as expired.

nodes.name: Post To Facebook
nodes.notes: Page access token lives in a header-auth credential, so it never appears in this export.
